Usage: memoriahub backup prune [options]

List (and with --yes permanently delete) quarantined backup files

Options:
  --yes                Actually delete the quarantined files (default: dry run)
  --older-than <days>  Only entries quarantined more than N days ago
  --json               Emit the listing as JSON
  -h, --help           display help for command

A reconcile run moves files the server no longer lists into <root>/_quarantine/
instead of deleting them. This command is the ONLY way those bytes are removed.
Without --yes it prints what WOULD be deleted and exits.
